text:
sam: heads-up: ran into a weird combo today installing redwoodctl on a locked-down Win Server image. One-liner fails (TLS/proxy), manual script copy works but login flow stalls during `device_code` verification.

ana: we saw similar in corp images where the CA intercepts TLS and the auth endpoint returns HTML. Did you capture the response body?

sam: yep, body was an HTML login page from the corp proxy. After I got past that and used `--browser=none`, the CLI printed the device code but verification returned `invalid_client` briefly, then succeeded after ~30s.

chris: sounds like two issues: cert/proxy causing the initial install trouble and a transient race on the auth server when using device-code flow. There's an open fix to increase verification retries with backoff (PR 2204).

sam: workaround I used: 1) download installer on an internet-connected laptop 2) verify SHA256 and copy to the server 3) run installer with `powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1` 4) run `redwoodctl login --browser=none` on the laptop, grab `REDWOOD_TOKEN` from `~/.redwood/config.yaml` and set as env on the server.

ana: to add: if the server enforces a global config via REDWOOD_CONFIG_PATH, the installer used to append causing duplicate `profiles:` keys. We added `redwoodctl profiles import --from <path> --set-current <name>` to handle merges safely.

sam: confirmed import works. One UX nit: `--set-current` requires explicit profile name. took a sec to realize.

chris: noted. we'll add an alias `--auto-select` and improve importer to set the first profile when not provided. Ticket DX-561.

infra-bot: scheduled deploy for redwoodctl v0.12.3 (includes auth retry/backoff and safe import) - ETA 40m.

sam: last question — local serve defaults to 0.0.0.0 which our host firewall blocks. Is there a persistent setting?

chris: yep, add `local:
  host: 127.0.0.1` to ~/.redwood/config.yaml or use `redwoodctl local serve --host 127.0.0.1`. We'll add the note to the quickstart doc.

sam: thanks all. Leaving steps in DX-562 so support can link to them.
